args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on v2.3.1 across all regions.
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.

Let me roll back.
